verbs.name: slcode.new
verbs.help: Open a slcode session card in the deck of this terminal; prints the session id

args.name: model
args.help: model of the new session (default: the vendor's default); anthropic:<model> or openai:<model> also picks the vendor (claude | codex)

args.name: effort
args.help: effort of the new session — claude: low | medium | high | xhigh | max (default: the vendor's default; a value the model lacks warns in the session and falls back to the default)

args.name: profile
args.help: start profile of the new session — default | bare | one made with slcode profile add (default: default; before the first message it can be changed in the middle of the chat)

args.name: env
args.help: env of the session's Claude/Codex process, kept for resume and vendor restarts; several pairs go in one value, one per line (a repeated --env keeps only the last); SLCODE_* names are refused

args.name: prompt
args.help: first prompt — starts the first turn as soon as the session is up

args.name: focus
args.help: show the new card if you are looking at this terminal right then (default: attach it quietly; slcode new passes it when a person types it)

verbs.name: slcode.start
verbs.help: Open the slcode start screen as a card in the deck of this terminal — new session (pick a profile), resume a closed session, add a profile

args.name: cwd
args.help: folder of the start screen (default: this shell's cwd)

verbs.name: slcode.resume
verbs.help: Open a saved slcode session as a card in the deck of this terminal; without --id, pick a closed session of --cwd

args.name: cwd
args.help: folder whose closed sessions to pick from (default: this shell's cwd)

settings.title: slcode
settings.description: slcode 세션 카드. 카드를 닫으면 세션도 끝난다.

items.label: slcode command
items.description: 비우면 플러그인이 받은 slcode. 넣으면 그것을 쓴다 (PATH 의 이름 또는 데몬 머신의 절대 경로)
